stays.title: Mehrangarh Citadel Fortress Retreat
stays.description: Perched 400 feet above the Blue City on a burnished cliff, sleep within fortified sandstone walls once guarded by Rathore sovereigns.

stays.title: The Rambagh Royal Pavilion & Palace
stays.description: Former residence of the Maharaja of Jaipur. Adorned with hand-carved marble latticework, lush Mughal gardens, and crystal chandeliers.

stays.title: Mandawa Ancestral Frescoed Haveli
stays.description: An open-air art gallery featuring hand-painted natural pigment frescoes, carved brass doorways, and peaceful inner courtyards.

stays.title: Villa San Michele Medici Estate
stays.description: Nestled on the Florentine hills with a facade attributed to Michelangelo. Former Franciscan monastery overlooking the Arno Valley.

stays.title: Castillo de Santa Catalina Moorish Alcazar
stays.description: Gothic cross vaults and Moorish towers perched high above the Andalusian olive valleys with defensive battlements and chivalric banqueting halls.

stays.title: Patwon Ki Haveli Golden Mansion
stays.description: Carved out of yellow Thar Desert sandstone with 60 delicate stone jharokhas (balconies) that illuminate into molten gold at twilight.

stays.title: Palazzo Dandolo Doge Residence
stays.description: Historic palazzo of Venetian nobility overlooking the lagoon. Featuring Murano crystal, silk damask wall coverings, and private water gates.

stays.title: Château de Montmirail
stays.description: Sprawling French chateau surrounded by ancient moats, classical topiary parterres, and gilded salons inspired by Versailles.

transport.title: The Royal Orient Luxury Express
transport.description: Gilded maharaja train with teak wood interiors, royal dining carriages, personal khidmatgars, and sweeping desert vistas.

transport.title: The Venice Simplon-Orient-Express
transport.description: The quintessential golden age of rail. Original 1920s Art Deco sleeping cars, crystal glassware, and white-glove black-tie service.

transport.title: Aerial Citadel Heli-Safari
transport.route: Amber Fort — Jaigarh — Nahargarh Fortress Run
transport.description: Soar above defensive stone ramparts, hidden fortress moats, and royal ridge-line sentry outposts with an aerial historian.

transport.title: Theban Kings Valley Archaeo-Copter
transport.route: Luxor — Karnak — Hatshepsut Temple — Valley of Kings
transport.description: Breathtaking low-altitude flight tracing Pharaoh tombs, towering colossal statues of Memnon, and the Nile river bends.

transport.title: 1948 Royal Enfield Classic 500 Cruiser
transport.description: Handcrafted vintage thumper fitted with brass accents and leather saddlebags. The classic choice for traversing ancient trade passes.

transport.title: 1962 Triumph Bonneville Heritage Ride
transport.description: Twin-cylinder British icon tuned to perfection for winding through cypress-lined hills and Renaissance hilltop hamlets.

transport.title: Nile Royal Handcrafted Dahabiya Cruise
transport.description: A tranquil traditional twin-sailed wooden river yacht without noisy motors, stopping at secluded island temples and village quays.

transport.title: 1938 Douglas DC-3 Historic Sky Journey
transport.description: Step into the dawn of civil aviation aboard a fully restored twin-engine prop aircraft with leather reclining lounge chairs.

experiences.title: Master Historian Private Walk: Roman Forum & Imperial Crypts
experiences.description: Led by an Oxford Classical Antiquity PhD. Gain keys to underground pagan shrines and closed Senatorial meeting chambers.

experiences.title: VIP Archaeo-Pass: Active Tomb Excavation Access
experiences.location: Valley of the Kings, Luxor, Egypt
experiences.description: Wear specialized protective boots to enter non-public active conservation shafts with the chief field archaeologist.

experiences.title: Solitary Twilight Access: Petra Treasury & Siq Gorge
experiences.description: Walk through the Siq Canyon illuminated only by 1,500 beeswax lanterns after all tourist gates are locked for the night.

experiences.title: Colosseum Underground Hypogeum & Arena Nocturne
experiences.description: Descend into subterranean trapdoor lift systems and beast cages beneath the moonlit sands of the Flavian Amphitheatre.

experiences.title: Court Calligrapher & Epigrapher Masterclass
experiences.description: Learn to read 1,000-year-old Heian wooden scrolls and grind pine-soot ink inside an unesco temple annex.

experiences.title: Stonehenge Inner Monolith Solstice Circle Pass
experiences.description: Step inside the inner sarsen trilithons during dawn stillness when ordinary barriers are retracted for scientific permit holders.

ancillaries.title: Diplomatic & Heritage Fast-Track E-Visa
ancillaries.description: Expedited pre-clearance and consular stamps for ancient travel corridors and archaeological research sanctuaries.

ancillaries.title: Sovereign Gold Multi-Currency Antique Forex Card
ancillaries.description: Zero mark-up foreign exchange card accepted across 160 historical territories with built-in traveler theft immunity.

ancillaries.title: Royal Expedition & Archaeological Travel Insurance
ancillaries.description: Comprehensive Lloyd's backed policy covering remote mountain fort rescues, antique artifact damage liability, and flight changes.
